subject: Post-demo: stakeholder journey, procurement steps & evidence commitments
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder journey, procurement steps & evidence commitments

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and the Medisys team on the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment on stakeholders and evidence cadence: 

1) Stakeholder map (what we captured today)
   - Security lead: Alex Rivera (you) — primary security contact
   - Legal: will introduce — you mentioned in the call
   - Procurement / Sourcing: procurement@medisyshealth.com (you flagged a standard RFx process)
   - Economic buyer: pending confirmation (you mentioned CFO Maria Gomez may sign off)

2) Critical decision criteria you listed
   - SOC 2 Type II (controls mapping + date range)
   - Pen test summary and high-level remediation status
   - Audit log sample + retention policy (format + retention windows)
   - Data residency / VPC/networking topology notes for PHI scope

3) What Redwood will deliver by EOD Tuesday (Oct 20):
   - SOC 2 executive summary (Type II, scope & coverage) — attachment to follow
   - Pen test high-level summary (redacted findings + mitigations)
   - Example audit-log export schema + sample CSV
   - Procurement packet (SLA, standard T&Cs, redlines we typically accept)

4) Asks from Medisys
   - Please confirm final economic buyer (name + email) so we can include them on the mutual action plan (MAP)
   - Confirm procurement timeline (expected PO window or contract committee cadence)
   - Any specific evidence format constraints (CSV columns, SSO/SCIM templates, KMS/HSM details)

5) Proposed next meeting: 30-min checkpoint with Security + Procurement + Neha (security engineering) on Wed Oct 21, 10am PT — is that feasible?

Attachments: none in this message; I will attach SOC2 / pen test samples in my follow-up to the email thread.

Thanks — will move these items into the HubSpot deal and our evidence tracker.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — Inference for product teams
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@medisyshealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisyshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder journey, procurement steps & evidence commitments

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@medisyshealth.com> (CFO). I'll copy her on the MAP after internal alignment.
- Legal: I'll request an intro to our contracts counsel, but procurement will be the initial gate for SOW/PO.
- Procurement timeline: likely 3-4 weeks once we receive the standard procurement packet (PO expected mid-November if redlines are modest).

Evidence / format asks from Security: 
- SOC 2: executive summary + control mapping (we don't need raw control testwork, but a mapping to relevant CCs is helpful)
- Pen test: one-page redacted findings + status on mitigations (we can accept the summary you mentioned)
- Audit logs: CSV sample with columns (timestamp, user_id, action, resource, request_id) and a note on retention policy (90 days hot, 2 years cold)
- Data residency: confirm whether log storage can be region-restricted to us-east-1 and whether encryption-at-rest uses a managed KMS (if customer-managed KMS supported)

Attached a short procurement template with the fields our team expects — this will help your legal/ops format defaults.

I'm okay with Wed Oct 21 10am PT for the 30-min checkpoint. Please include Neha on the invite and Marcus if procurement SOW discussion will be needed.

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Senior Security Engineer, Medisys Health
alex.rivera@medisyshealth.com

Attachments: procurement_requirements_from_medisyss.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@medisyshealth.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@medisyshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder journey, procurement steps & evidence commitments

Alex / Maria —

Thanks for confirming Maria and the procurement cadence. Per the call and your asks, attached are the artifacts we discussed (redacted where appropriate):

- SOC2_TypeII_Executive_Summary_2026.pdf — includes control mapping to SOC 2 CC categories and date range (Jan 1–Jun 30, 2026).
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf — high-level findings and remediation status; no sensitive PII included.
- audit_log_sample.csv — sample export with the columns you requested and a short README describing retention. (I uploaded the sample to the evidence tracker link in HubSpot as well.)

Short answers to your bullets: 
- Audit log retention: our default is 90 days hot, 2 years cold. If Medisys requires region-restricted storage we can confirm options — we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; hosted options will use our managed KMS with HKDF-based key separation.
- Evidence format: CSV with the columns you listed is fine; we'll also provide a JSON schema if you prefer a programmatic ingest.

Next steps / commitments: 
- By EOD Wed Oct 21: Marcus will share a draft SOW / procurement packet consistent with the procurement template you attached.
- Wed Oct 21 10am PT: 30-min checkpoint to align security + procurement expectations (invite pending).
- If Maria is available, we'd welcome a short intro call with the economic buyer next week to review commercial milestones — otherwise we'll include Maria in the MAP and send a one-pager summary.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Executive_Summary_2026.pdf (application/pdf), pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (application/pdf), audit_log_sample.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — we'll push these items into HubSpot (MED-4721) and the evidence tracker. Marcus / Neha — please see the action items below.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
